system.boundary: Build a Simscape Fluids model of a high-pressure hydrogen refueling station.
engineering_objects: Build a Simscape Fluids model of a high-pressure hydrogen refueling station.
The implemented physical paths must remain connected from storage to the vehicle.
Read p_storage, p_vehicle_init, T_env, and T_fluid from the MATLAB base workspace.
physical_paths: Hydrogen shall pass from a low-pressure supply through multistage compression with intercooling into a three-level cascade buffer.
The implemented physical paths must remain connected from storage to the vehicle.
Build a Simscape Fluids model of a high-pressure hydrogen refueling station.
Read p_storage, p_vehicle_init, T_env, and T_fluid from the MATLAB base workspace.
functional_paths: A controlled reduction valve and a precooling path shall then deliver hydrogen to a vehicle tank.

Measured vehicle-tank pressure and delivered-hydrogen temperature shall regulate the dispensing valve and the precooling action, while a supervisory sequence selects an available cascade buffer as the vehicle pressure rises.
These must be physical or implemented controller measurements, not prescribed output waveforms.
information_paths: p_storage, p_vehicle_init, T_env, T_fluid -> F90-XFLUID-09 plant/control path -> VehiclePressure_bar, VehicleTemperature_C, VehicleMassFlow_kg_s, ReductionValveCommand, BufferPressure_bar
modes_and_events: Build a Simscape Fluids model of a high-pressure hydrogen refueling station.
The model must operate with p_storage from 180 to 220 bar, p_vehicle_init from 50 to 200 bar, T_env from 15 to 35 degC, and T_fluid from -60 to -45 degC.
